title: Wi-Fi client password guards execute text and continue destructive changes
summary: Invalid password guards invoke a quoted message as a command instead of __ALERT. Exact isolated-function stubs show password x writes configuration/disables or deletes the old connection and returns OK despite command-not-found. Reject invalid length before mutations and test lower/upper bounds plus valid controls. No network/service/reboot was executed. Next action: coordinator assigns a focused repair and relevant regression.
